species: Human THP-1 cells (ACC-16; DSMZ, Braunschweig, Germany) were cultured at 37 °C in RPMI-1640 supplemented with 10% FCS and 1% penicillin and streptomycin.
tissue: We then aimed to determine whether BEAS-2B derived EVs contain proteins that are specific for lung epithelium-derived EVs.
cell_type: Conditioned media of BEAS-2B bronchial epithelial cells were concentrated on 10 kDa centrifuge filters, followed by separation of EVs and free protein using sepharose CL-4B SEC.
sample_source: For this purpose, conditioned cell culture media were processed either by UF-SEC or, for comparison, by ultracentrifugation (UC) or ultracentrifugation including a wash step (UC-wash; illustrated in Fig. 1).
